item.title: My new song “Jekyll & Hyde” is OT NOW! This song is abou...
item.description: My new song “Jekyll & Hyde” is OT NOW! This song is about embracing every side of yourself. The good, the bad, the scary, the wild, the beautiful. All of these things can exist within us at once, and every side deserves to be seen.Go give it a listen, share it with someone, and celebrate all the beautifully complicated parts of being human.A huge thank you to my friend + bandmate Roberto Sanchez. Just the two of us brought this song to life at his studio, Static West. The whole process felt serendipitous & inspiring & FN!Thank you to @dannybones64 for weaving some soulful harmonica flourishes into the track. Honored to have a little piece of his magic alongside my own harmonica playing And my talented friend @_maryclementine for bringing my vision for the cover art to life! I wanted a yin to the yang counterpart to one of Warren B Davis crescent ladies… Mary makes my dreams come true Written & Produced: @monicavalliRecorded & Co-produced: Roberto SanchezMixed & Mastered: Erik WoffordCover Art: @_maryclementineMusic Video Coming Soon!
